mapper.select: SELECT SRVC_INFO.SRVC_SEQ , SRVC_INFO.SRVC_CD , SRVC_INFO.SRVC_CTGRY_CD , SRVC_INFO.SRVC_TP , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GRP_CD = 'SVC_SRVC_INFO_001' AND CD = SRVC_INFO.SRVC_TP ) AS SRVC_TP_NM , SRVC_INFO.USE_YN , SRVC_INFO.SRVC_NM , SRVC_INFO.SRVC_BSC_URI , SRVC_INFO.SRVC_DESC , TO_CHAR(SRVC_INFO.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , SRVC_INFO.RGST_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = SRVC_INFO.RGST_SEQ ) AS RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(SRVC_INFO.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , SRVC_INFO.UPDT_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = SRVC_INFO.UPDT_SEQ ) AS UPDT_NM FROM SVC_SRVC_INFO_TBL SRVC_INFO WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SRVC_INFO.USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{srvcCtgryCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{srvcCtgryCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SRVC_INFO.SRVC_CTGRY_CD = #{srvcCtgryCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{srvcTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{srvcTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SRVC_INFO.SRVC_TP = #{srvcTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{srvcNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{srvcNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SRVC_INFO.SRVC_NM LIKE '%' || #{srvcNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'))

SELECT SRVC_INFO.SRVC_SEQ , SRVC_INFO.SRVC_CD , SRVC_INFO.SRVC_CTGRY_CD , SRVC_INFO.SRVC_TP , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GRP_CD = 'SVC_SRVC_INFO_001' AND CD = SRVC_INFO.SRVC_TP ) AS SRVC_TP_NM , SRVC_INFO.USE_YN , SRVC_INFO.SRVC_NM , SRVC_INFO.SRVC_BSC_URI , SRVC_INFO.SRVC_DESC , TO_CHAR(SRVC_INFO.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , SRVC_INFO.RGST_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = SRVC_INFO.RGST_SEQ ) AS RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(SRVC_INFO.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , SRVC_INFO.UPDT_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = SRVC_INFO.UPDT_SEQ ) AS UPDT_NM FROM SVC_SRVC_INFO_TBL SRVC_INFO WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{srvcSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL) OR (#{srvcSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0)) OR (SRVC_INFO.SRVC_SEQ = #{srvcSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC})) AND (((#{srvcCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{srvcCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (SRVC_INFO.SRVC_CD = #{srvcCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))
SELECT CASE WHEN ( COUNT(SRVC_CD) > 0 ) THEN true ELSE false END FROM SVC_SRVC_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND SRVC_CTGRY_CD = #{srvcCtgryCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SRVC_CD = #{srvcCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.delete: UPDATE SVC_SRVC_INFO_TBL SET USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{srvcSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL) OR (#{srvcSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0)) OR (SRVC_SEQ = #{srvcSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}))
